Context: 10. Retention of Accommodation

Retention of accommodation "by allottee availing leave and Joining The allottee on transfer shall be allowed to retain the accommo dation for two months or for the period of their leave not exceeding four months, whichever is more, if the leave has been sanctioned before  
Time.-(1) relinquishment of charge:  
Provided that an allottee availing joining time after expiry of leave at the old station, may be allowed to retain the accommodation until the expiry of the period of joining time.
